text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week is overwhelmed by the sight of Grass Wonder's famed strength, which is heralded as the strongest of their generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I put my body on the line to stop her from acting recklessly out of sheer frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week reflects on the path we've taken and regains her confidence. She directs her new focus toward the Arima Kinen.
